instantiated_cells.cited_section: Tex. Gov’t Code §§ 305.031 (criminal penalties for violations, incl. false statements), 305.032 (civil penalty for failure to file registration or activities report), 305.033 (civil penalty for late filing)
instantiated_cells.justification: Chapter 305 expressly imposes criminal penalties for violations and civil penalties for failure to register/file and for late filings, satisfying the requirement that penalties be defined for lobbying disclosure violations.

instantiated_cells.cited_section: Tex. Gov’t Code § 305.033(a) (commission determines lateness); § 305.034(a) (commission determines whether required forms/reports filed); § 305.009 (maintenance/retention)
instantiated_cells.justification: The statute provides for commission review of timeliness and completeness of filings but contains no requirement for regular auditing of lobbying disclosure records by an impartial third party.
